candidates.name: V11-final
candidates.role: final design = V8 transport/porosity set + h=50: nail margin raised (T_max 336 K vs 349 K at h=40; h=30 fails at 666 s) at negligible plating cost; DFN-precision verification round

llm_reason: R4 sensitivity sweep mapped the nail cooling floor at h~40 W/m2K (h=40 passes T_max 348.7 K, h=30 triggers at 666 s). Choosing h=50 as the design value gives comfortable nail margin while the plating margin loss from slightly cooler operation is negligible (V6 vs V1: h had minor effect on anode min). V11 = V8 + h=50 is the final candidate; R5 verifies it at DFN precision (1C discharge DFN + calc-energy + 4C DFN + aging + nail).
